cards.card_text: Then Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
cards.verse_text: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
cards.snippet: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.

cards.card_text: Moses ends with, "you will be the cause of their destruction." Then the Gadites and Reubenites come back with a new pitch: sheepfolds here for their livestock and cities for their little ones, and friend, I'm LISTENING.
cards.verse_text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.” Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
cards.snippet: …the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

cards.card_text: Then the song turns to the clans of Reuben, who sat among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks.
cards.verse_text: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks?
cards.snippet: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks?

cards.card_text: Along the road, Saul comes to some sheepfolds where there's a cave, and he goes in to relieve himself.
cards.verse_text: Soon Saul came to the sheepfolds along the road, where there was a cave, and he went in to relieve himself.
cards.snippet: Soon Saul came to the sheepfolds along the road, where there was a cave, and he went in…

cards.card_text: Then the song says that though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the dove's wings are covered with silver and her feathers with shimmering gold.
cards.verse_text: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
cards.snippet: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers…

cards.card_text: Then God chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds.
cards.verse_text: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
cards.snippet: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;

cards.card_text: Now He paints a picture: a sheepfold, a gate and some sheep.
cards.verse_text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
cards.snippet: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief…

cards.card_text: In Jesus' picture, somebody skips the gate and climbs into the sheepfold some other way.
